children: Elon Musk's the Boring Company has raised $3 billion in a Series D funding round, valuing the company at $23 billion.
The funding round was led by the United Arab Emirates and affiliated investment entities, the tunneling startup said Wednesday.
Other investors include venture capital firms Human Capital and Sequoia Capital, private-equity company Valor Equity Partners and Singapore state-investment firm Temasek.

The investment will boost the startup's partnership with the U.A.E. to deploy underground infrastructure across the country, including more than 150 kilometers of tunnel, said the Boring Co. This is in addition to the Dubai Loop tunneling project previously awarded to the Boring Co.
